name: 吳柏輝
objective:
本課程將介紹工程上、物理上系統解析的相關數學工具，內容包括：1. 常微分方程式：一階，二階，及高階常微分方程，2. 拉譜拉斯轉換，3. 特殊函數。
This course intends to introduce the mathematical principles and practices that today's engineers need to know. The course contents are 1.Ordinary Differential Eqs: 1st order, 2nd order and higher order ODEs. 2. Laplace transform, 3. Special function.
課程進度(1-16週):
1	課程簡介與目標
2	First-Order ODEs
3	First-Order ODEs
4	First-Order ODEs
5	Second-Order Linear ODEs
6	Second-Order Linear ODEs
7	Second-Order Linear ODEs
8	Higher Order Linear ODEs
9	期中測驗
10	Higher Order Linear ODEs
11	Higher Order Linear ODEs
12	Series Solutions of ODEs. Special Functions
13	Series Solutions of ODEs. Special Functions
14	Series Solutions of ODEs. Special Functions
15	Laplace Transforms
16	期末測驗
17	彈性學習
18	彈性學習
※ 課程進度與內容將視學生學習情況適度調整。
